key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Spotlight. Default is Ctrl+Space.

key.name: theme-preference
key.description: Color theme for Spotlight. Values: default (follows system), dark, light.

key.name: glass-tint
key.description: Tint color of the liquid glass as an rgba() string.

key.name: glass-tint-strength
key.description: How strongly the tint colors the glass, percent.

key.name: glass-blur
key.description: Refraction blur of the liquid glass.

key.name: glass-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the glass panel in pixels.

key.name: glass-saturation
key.description: Color saturation of the liquid glass, percent.

key.name: glass-refraction
key.description: Refraction strength (edge distortion) of the liquid glass.

key.name: glass-engine
key.description: Source sampled by the liquid glass: full (windows and wallpaper) or wallpaper (wallpaper only, most compatible).
